title: IBM Rosa Sixty Thousand
description: IBM Themed Font Pack that requires Caxton to work
body:
# IBM Rosa Sixty Thousand

This IBM Themed Font Pack uses the 2370 IBM font for its appearance, almost makes you want to get an IBM RS/6000 just for the funnies, also to test out early iPXE (NIM)

The Font is a modern format of a font with high nostalgic value
